sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • U.S.-Iran framework agreement lands, driving broad risk appetite: The U.S. authorized the "free opening of the Strait of Hormuz" and lifted the naval blockade, with formal signing scheduled for this Friday (a market holiday; the community strongly questioned whether this timing was "because the agreement can’t stand up to scrutiny"). But the details were astonishing—the U.S. is reportedly committed to providing Iran with roughly $300 billion in "reconstruction funds," while after a 60-day exemption period, Iran will collect "service fee" tolls for passage through the Strait. The community broadly interpreted this as a "substantive U.S. concession/surrender," but nobody cares whether it’s true or false; as long as oil flows and algos eat the headlines, the pump continues. As of 13:12 ET, SPY +1.91% at 755.8 (intraday high 756.68, one step away from ATH), QQQ +3.07% at 743.47 leading gains, DIA +1.41%.
  • Oil plunges as the peace dividend gets priced in: USO -4.3%, XLE -2.8%; the energy sector was priced as if "the Strait has already been open for a year," and the community was baffled that XOM/CVX fell below pre-war prices.
  • Netanyahu 2PM press conference becomes a suspense point: Israel refused to withdraw from Lebanon and reserved the right to strike Hezbollah. The community worried Bibi could disrupt things this week (~30% probability), but for now the market is completely ignoring it.
  • SpaceX(SPCX) speculative frenzy: On the second trading day after IPO, +13% at 182 (intraday high 184.4), up about 36% over two days, with market cap nearing $2.3 trillion and surpassing TSM. Today is IPO settlement day, and the underwriters’ overallotment option (83.3 million shares @135) enters its exercisable period. Options are reportedly listing tomorrow, and the community is wildly excited.
  • MSFT hit by shareholder class-action lawsuit: A Michigan pension fund led a lawsuit alleging Microsoft concealed slowing Azure growth and surging AI capex, inflating its share price. But today MSFT still +2.3%, repeatedly battling around the 400 level, leaving the community collectively confused that it could "somehow be green."
  • FOMC 6/16-17 (Wednesday decision): Warsh’s debut; the market is 97% pricing in a hold at 3.5-3.75%, with focus on whether the dot plot and wording shift from dovish to neutral.

社区氛围：极度欣快、乐观，以欣快感为主；空头已被彻底污名化并被消灭，整个董事会都在高喊“ber is fuk”的胜利口号。但交易量低（SPY 仅为日均交易量的三分之一）、IBM 独自亏损、债券收益率上升以及 IWM 表现明显不佳形成暗流，而经验丰富的玩家在接近顶部时隐隐感到不安。

恐惧/贪婪：社区自我报告的恐惧与贪婪指数约为 42（仍处于“恐惧”区域），与极度贪婪的价格行为形成巨大背离——这正是 WSB 反复嘲笑机构“恐惧时贪婪”的基础。情绪与价格行为：社区情绪比实际收益更激动；单边多头定位已经极其拥挤。 “卖出就顶了”等自嘲与“theta无聊”并存，逆势警示值不断上升。
